review_requirements: Independently verify the governing protocol/SAP identity, version binding, and chronology.
Recheck every evidence quotation against the cited one-based physical PDF page.
Adjudicate all reference-only and needs-confirmation decisions before freezing.

Post-start exception: no formal interim analysis was planned; only an independent DSMB could review grouped unblinded safety results while investigators remained blinded, and the selected target predates actual primary completion.
